steps.name: 슬라이드 속성(요소 선택 없음) - 글꼴 세트 선택 상자가 패널 안
steps.js: const P=document.querySelector('#tab-props'); const sel=document.querySelector('select[data-slide="fontPreset"]'); const d=document.querySelector('select[data-deckfont]'); if(!sel||!d) return 'no selects'; const pr=P.getBoundingClientRect().right; const w1=sel.closest('.scrollx').getBoundingClientRect(), w2=d.closest('.scrollx').getBoundingClientRect(); return w1.right<=pr+1 && w2.right<=pr+1 ? true : 'sel right='+w1.right+' deck right='+w2.right+' panel right='+pr

steps.name: 긴 선택지는 칸 안에서 가로 스크롤
steps.js: const d=document.querySelector('select[data-deckfont]'); const box=d.closest('.scrollx'); return box.scrollWidth>=box.clientWidth ? true : 'sw='+box.scrollWidth+' cw='+box.clientWidth

steps.name: 색 선택 상자도 패널 안
steps.js: document.querySelector('[data-sel="e01"]').click(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,400)); const P=document.querySelector('#tab-props').getBoundingClientRect().right; const bad=[...document.querySelectorAll('#tab-props select')].filter(s=>s.getBoundingClientRect().right>P+1); return bad.length===0 ? true : 'overflow='+bad.length
